steps.title: open vlabench gripper · locate vlabench entity · grasp vlabench entity
steps.code:
primitives.call(name='open_vlabench_gripper', horizon=5)
r1 = primitives.call(name='locate_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', query='rose stem grasp point')
rose_h = r1.output.get('evidence_handle'); rose_t = r1.output.get('world_target')
print('rose', r1.ok, rose_h, rose_t)
g = primitives.call(name='grasp_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', evidence_handles=[rose_h], max_n_substep=15)
print('grasp', g.ok)
if g.ok:
    l = primitives.call(name='lift_vlabench_ee', evidence_handles=[rose_h], lift_height=0.15, gripper_state=-1.0)
    print('lift', l.ok)
    obs = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', query='grasp check')
    ev = obs.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {})
    print('grasped', ev.get('grasped_obj_name'))
    print('rose', ev.get('entity_evidence', {}).get('rose', {}).get('xpos'))

steps.title: locate vlabench entity · open vlabench gripper · move vlabench ee to
steps.code:
v = primitives.call(name='locate_vlabench_entity', entity_name='vase_seen', query='vase rim')
vase_h = v.output.get('evidence_handle'); vase_t = v.output.get('world_target')
print('vase', vase_h, vase_t)
primitives.call(name='open_vlabench_gripper', horizon=5)
r1 = primitives.call(name='locate_vlabench_entity', entity_name='rose', query='rose stem')
rose_h = r1.output.get('evidence_handle'); rose_t = r1.output.get('world_target')
print('rose', rose_h, rose_t)
m = primitives.call(name='move_vlabench_ee_to', evidence_handles=[rose_h], target_site='grasp', horizon=20, gripper_state=1.0)
print('approach', m.ok, m.output.get('end_ee_position'), m.output.get('distance_to_target'))
c = primitives.call(name='close_vlabench_gripper', horizon=8)
print('close', c.ok)
l = primitives.call(name='lift_vlabench_ee', evidence_handles=[rose_h], lift_height=0.2, gripper_state=-1.0)
print('lift', l.ok)
o = primitives.call(name='observe_vlabench_scene', query='grasp check')
ev = o.output.get('object_grounding_evidence', {})
print('grasped', ev.get('grasped_obj_name'))
print('rose pos', ev.get('entity_evidence', {}).get('rose', {}).get('xpos'))
